heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: A swarm of lovely beetles, mistaking the maids face for the lotus blossom, her smiling mouth of white teeth for the lily, her eyes for the blue lotus, her uneven fingers for a cluster of kanthal buds, hanker after these and ever live in her company. Through the shades befitting such swarms of beetles, thy daughter without any hindrance sweetly passed. (Thus say the travellers to the foster-mother who has started to search for her eloped charge) Balakrishna Mudaliyar
